subject: Renewal: regional bridge deployment + EU residency + APAC failover
messages:
From: Sian O'Neill <sian.oneill@coralhealth.ie>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-05T09:14:00Z
Subject: Renewal + residency + APAC failover options

Hi Rohan,

Our renewal window for CoralHealth comes up at the end of December and we need to bake in two things this cycle: EU data residency (primary) for patient data and an APAC warm-standby/cross-region failover capability to handle Asian traffic spikes.

Current notes:
- Avg tokens/day: 18M; peak p95 concurrency: ~120 rps
- We expect a 2x throughput need in APAC during weekdays for the next 12 months
- Procurement needs: a clear SOW, pricing for an upsell of capacity, and any residency addendum wording

Can you share a rough plan and pricing for: 1) enabling a dedicated EU tenancy with guaranteed residency (log arc retention options), 2) APAC warm-standby with automated failover, and 3) any recommended term changes (commit length, discounts)?

Also attaching a small usage export for your sizing.

Thanks,
Sian O'Neill
Head of Product Ops, CoralHealth Systems
[Attachment: current_usage_report.csv (csv)]
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sian O'Neill <sian.oneill@coralhealth.ie>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-06T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + residency + APAC failover options

Hi Sian — thanks for the context and the usage export. Appreciate the timelines. High-level proposal below; happy to iterate based on procurement/legal asks.

Proposed phased approach:
1) EU Primary Residency (Phase 1) — deploy a dedicated EU tenancy (single-tenant or regional partition) with data-at-rest in EU, KMS integration, and audit logging. Target: 6 weeks from PO.
2) APAC Warm-Standby + Failover (Phase 2) — maintain a warm pool in APAC with cross-region health checks and automatic traffic cutover; prefix/KV sync and cached-model pre-warming included. Target: 4 weeks after Phase 1 greenlight.
3) Capacity Upsell — bump to 2x baseline reserved capacity for peak windows; include autoscale burst policy and cost caps.

Estimates (ballpark):
- EU residency onboarding & infra: $38k one-time + $6k/mo residency premium
- APAC warm-standby: $12k/mo for standby pool + $8k one-time runbook/setup
- Reserved capacity (2x): $0.045/GB-hr equivalent (detailed in attached pricing sheet)

Suggested commercial incentive (to land this in renewal): 12-month term commit on the combined package, 15% discount on monthly fees, and one month of APAC warm-standby free as a pilot.

Next steps I suggest:
- Marissa to draft SOW + residency addendum
- Ben to produce a tech-runbook for the failover and ROI numbers
- I’ll prepare a preliminary price/PO template and DocuSign ready SOW

I’ve attached a prelim SOW draft and the capacity pricing sheet for your team to review. If we can get procurement feedback this week (PO timing?), we can lock the timeline.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Prelim_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Capacity_pricing_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Sian O'Neill <sian.oneill@coralhealth.ie>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@coralhealth.ie>
Cc: Alicia Long <alicia.long@coralhealth.ie>
Date: 2029-12-07T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + residency + APAC failover options

Thanks Rohan — looping in procurement and IT/security. A few items they need before we can accept the commercial proposal:
- Completed security questionnaire and SOC 2 Type II evidence
- Data flow diagram and retention policy for EU tenancy (GDPR column)
- SLA on failover RTO/RPO and test windows for the warm-standby
- Contract redline: we typically ask for a 60-day notice for major infra changes and a clear data export process

I’m attaching our filled vendor questionnaire to speed review. Can you confirm whether the EU tenancy option is a fully isolated tenancy (no shared compute with us) and whether keys are customer-managed? Also need a draft PoC/test schedule for failover drills.

Procurement note (Tom): we’ll target internal sign-off week of Dec 16 if we have the SOW and evidence by Dec 12.

Best,
Sian
[Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_filled.pdf (pdf)]
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-12-09T14:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: CoralHealth renewal — redlines & SOW

Marissa / Ben — forwarding CoralHealth's notes. Key asks: SOC2 evidence, customer-managed keys option, explicit RTO/RPO for failover, and a contract clause around 60-day infra-change notice. Procurement wants sign-off during week of Dec 16 if we can get them artifacts by Dec 12.

My commercial approach suggestion (provisionally):
- Offer 12-month committed term for the new bundle (EU residency + APAC warm-standby + 2x reserved capacity) with 15% discount on monthly fees.
- Include an SLA-backed failover test cadence (quarterly) and a one-month free APAC warm-standby pilot on contract signature.
- Push the one-time EU onboarding fee to account implementation budget (offset into first invoice) to reduce immediate sticker shock.

Action items:
- Marissa: please draft SOW + residency addendum addressing KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed) and the 60-day notice language.
- Ben: produce the tech runbook with estimated warm pool size, expected failover RTO/RPO, and a short test plan (2–3 bullet drill steps).
- Rohan: finalize pricing sheet and prepare DocuSign envelope linked below.

>>> Internal quick notes (do not forward):
>>> - If they commit to 12 months, margin after discount still acceptable; we can tighten burst pricing later.
>>> - Consider including a preorder credit for any extra nodes they deploy within first 6 months to encourage capacity adoption.

[Attachment: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Rohan
From: Sian O'Neill <sian.oneill@coralhealth.ie>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@coralhealth.ie>, Alicia Long <alicia.long@coralhealth.ie>
Date: 2029-12-11T16:22:00Z
Subject: Approved: scope and signature

Rohan — thanks for the quick turnaround. We’ve reviewed the prelim SOW and the pricing model internally. CoralHealth is prepared to:

- Commit to the 12-month term for the combined package (EU residency + APAC warm-standby + 2x reserved capacity) subject to a finalized SOW and the SOC2 evidence;
- Accept the 15% discount and the one-month free APAC pilot;
- Procurement (Tom) will issue a PO the week of Dec 17; we need the DocuSign-ready SOW and an updated addendum with KMS options by end of day Dec 12.

Please send the final SOW + DocuSign link and a short test schedule for the failover drill. Once we have that, Tom will circulate the PO.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to getting this into implementation quickly.

Best,
Sian O'Neill
Head of Product Ops, CoralHealth Systems
[Signed]
